newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor sees Billiton LSE listing July 28.
newsitem.headline: Gencor sees Billiton LSE listing July 28.

text.p: Gencor Ltd said on Friday it expected the London Stock Exchange (LSE) would approve the listing of Billiton Plc on July 28, from which date the listing would be effective.
The South African mining house said last month it planned to list Billiton, grouping its base metals operations, on the LSE and raise $1 billion in an international equity placement.
The last day to register in order to participate in the distribution of shares in Billiton would be July 25, Gencor said.
